name: B2 (Window Room)
summary: Compact east-facing lockable studio in a multidisciplinary Brunswick arts warehouse, with natural light, fibre internet, shared facilities and 24/7 access.

name: Studio 118 — artist studios
summary: Lockable artist studios in a large creative community. Current practices include painting, printmaking, screen printing, jewellery, textiles and design; includes a large sink and washout facilities.

name: Space Module / The Mezzanine
summary: Lockable maker spaces with access to a shared CAD/CAM/CNC workshop, wood and metal tools, coworking/gallery space and 24-hour building access.

name: Pink Ember Studios
summary: Queer-run not-for-profit artist cooperative with light-filled studios, retail shop, workshop area and emerging ceramics facilities.

name: Manallack Studios Brunswick
summary: Private floor-to-ceiling studios with windows, quiet work areas, wash-up facilities and 24-hour access. Suitable for art, craft, illustration, photography and other low-impact practices.

name: Space Tank Studio
summary: Large maker studio and factory environment with rentable studios plus manufacturing and prototyping equipment including CNC, 3D printing, fabrication and workshop machinery.
price: from A$740/month + GST; casual access from A$95/day

name: Frith St Studios
summary: Small light-filled studio with sealed floor, solid walls, wash bay, utilities and 24-hour access, within the same building as Visual Diary gallery.

name: The Mezzanine — gallery / event workspace
summary: Short-term warehouse-style space above Space Module for exhibitions, meetings, photoshoots and other creative uses.

name: Craft Crits — August
address: Craft Victoria, Watson Place, Melbourne VIC 3000 / online
summary: Thirty-minute one-on-one feedback sessions with Craft staff tailored to makers' practice, goals and professional-development needs; available in person or online.
price: members: one free session/year then A$25; non-members A$50

name: Craft Members Vitrine Gallery — application info session
address: Online / Craft Victoria, Watson Place, Melbourne VIC 3000
summary: Free information session about applying to exhibit in Craft's Members Vitrine Gallery, a pathway for members to present innovative and experimental work.
availability: info session 15 Sep 2026 — check source for booking

name: First Site Gallery — Expressions of Interest
address: First Site Gallery, Storey Hall Basement, 344 Swanston Street, Melbourne VIC 3000
summary: Annual exhibition EOI pathway for RMIT students, designed to give emerging artists and designers experience presenting work publicly. Calls open annually at the end of Semester 2.

name: Folds Rips Cuts — submit an artwork
address: RMIT Gallery, 344 Swanston Street, Melbourne VIC 3000 / online
summary: An open participatory Sol LeWitt-inspired making program: follow the instructions, submit your work to RMIT Galleries and go into the running for prizes.
availability: running with The Concentric Influences of Sol LeWitt project
